CONSEQUENCE FOR THE GATE-PAIR HUNT: my dist/angle scan flags two apparent inversions on 57042 -- accepted 35009 at 49.9 cm / 24.0deg (site in_other_clusters_seg_cone) against rejected 51031 at 61.1 cm / 13.6deg, and against rejected 38012 at 62.8 cm / 22.7deg, both accepted-at-larger-angle within 15 cm. BOTH ARE FALSE. 51031 and 38012 are not rejected at all; they are members of 57042 that owner_map's first-owner-wins simply attributes elsewhere. This is a worked demonstration that an accept/reject flag taken from the display's owner column manufactures angle inversions, and any such pair has to be re-derived against the length reconciliation before it is believed.
